lightingIsotropy.method: 16-bin land-interior luma-gradient histogram; coastline pixels excluded by a two-pixel water clearance.

terrainFractions.method: Manual area estimate separating broad bench tops from cliff faces, talus, and broken shoreline ground.

waterMask.method: Border-connected blue-teal classification on the raw source, including pale water highlights and one-pixel enclosed highlight closure; visually checked with the diagnostic overlay.

crown.method: Manual native-source bounding-box census of all discernible conifer crowns, including saplings and edge-clipped crowns, then scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m/px.

failureReasons: The raw edit repainted fixed western context instead of limiting changes to the grey authoring area.
The raw source closes required western open-water intervals: the kept west edge at x=125 contains only 145/1254 water pixels (0.11563), far below the specified mixed edge with 49% sea.
The raw source therefore repeats the straight-cut/walled-inlet defect class and is not promotable even though the source-traced water mask itself is internally consistent.
verificationLimits: Visual quality and neighbour registration were not accepted; owner/director review remains authoritative.
The buildable/steep split is an area estimate rather than a semantic terrain classifier.
